Doorstep basket prawn toast.d: Ground with egg white, ginger and scallion, spread on white bread, sesame pressed on, fried golden and cut in triangles. Sweet chili sauce to dip.

Bagel chips and schmear.d: Day-old rounds sliced thin, brushed with olive oil and baked crisp. Cream cheese beaten with chives and lemon zest.

Peter's loft steak sandwich.d: Sirloin seared hard, rested and sliced thin. Onions cooked down slow in butter, horseradish mayo, Swiss melted on top, toasted sourdough.
Peter's loft steak sandwich.note: Drawn by Peter, cooked by Peter.

Baby Mary's bedtime vanilla custard.d: Hot milk whisked into yolks and sugar, stirred over low heat until thick and smooth. Warm, or chilled with the skin kept off.
Baby Mary's bedtime vanilla custard.note: Once she is down for the night.

Night-feed bourbon milk punch.d: Whole and cold, shaken hard over ice with vanilla, honey and a little sugar syrup until frothy. Nutmeg grated on top.
Night-feed bourbon milk punch.note: For whoever is up at 2 A.M.
